D-400 Schedule PN-1
2024 Other Additions and Other Deductions

DOR Use Only

If you enter an amount on Form D-400 Schedule PN, Part B, Line 17e or Line 19h, you must attach this schedule to Form D-400. Importantly, you must attach both pages of this schedule to Form D-400, even if you are only required to complete one part of the schedule. If you do not, the Department may be unable to process your return.
